candidates.term: The Sage inside the Month Gate
candidates.defline: The Sage holds your strongest seat, inside your Month Gate: your working years are carried by steady learning.
candidates.reading: Your working years rest on what you know, and you keep adding to it long after others stop studying. Because learning is how you feel safe, you prepare thoroughly for everything, and you wait to feel ready before you put yourself forward. Your ability has outrun your confidence for years, and the people who taught you have seen it sooner than you have. You gain your place slowly, and it lasts because it was built on trust.
candidates.teaser: Your prime is carried by learning: the deeper the study, the steadier the rise. Expect your name to rest on what you know, and to age well.

domain_readings.Mind: Learning carries your working life: the deeper the study, the steadier the rise. Your name comes to rest on what you know, and it ages the way references beat headlines. Publish, apply, teach before you feel ready. Your readiness always lagged your ability by years.
domain_readings.Career: Midlife converts your knowledge into quiet authority: students into allies, reading into rank. The career compounds through depth, never through noise. Trust the conversion. What you studied in obscurity gets promoted in daylight, reliably, on this seat’s schedule.
domain_readings.Growth: The hazard of your growth is gentle: shelter can become a reason to wait. Comfortable competence delays the leap this seat was built for. Set launch dates and honor them. Growth here needs deadlines the way gardens need fences.

candidates.life_chapter: Your rising chapter studies its way upward: the prime decades bank knowledge and midlife pays it out as authority. Expect the slow compounding to look like luck by fifty. It was homework. Set deadlines through these years, because your depth never volunteers its own.
candidates.relations: Teachers and students are this seat’s people, and the roles alternate: mentors who deepened you, then learners who sharpen you by asking. Family may not follow the studies. They follow the calm the studies produce. Both are the inheritance.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the depth defers: knowledge banked, application postponed. Teach or apply one thing this quarter. Depth pays only when drawn.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, the study shelters too well: learning as delay. Book the leap with a date on it.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, preparation becomes the profession: forever nearly ready.
candidates.health_line: Your system thrives on scholarly rhythm: reading, walking, sleeping in order. Chaos taxes you doubly. Keep the days shaped, and the mind keeps the body.

Mind.headline: You learn steadily, and it never stops.
Mind.recognition: Week by week you add to what you know, studying in a steady and patient way. Because understanding a thing fully is what makes you feel secure, you read the extra chapter and take the extra course, and you rarely feel finished. You know far more than you claim to.
Mind.lived: From your late teens learning carried you, through courses and qualifications and the teachers who took an interest. You have stayed a student in some form ever since, and it has kept you steadier than the people around you.

Career.headline: Your career rises on what you have studied.
Career.recognition: You are trusted at work because you know your subject properly, and people check their facts with you. Because depth matters more to you than visibility, you leave the self-promotion to others, and promotion reaches you later than it should. Your standing grows slowly and holds when louder careers fall away.
Career.lived: Since your late teens your progress at work has come through qualifications and the backing of people senior to you. At least once a senior colleague put your name forward before you felt ready, and you have proved them right.

Growth.headline: Your growth waits on a readiness you already have.
Growth.recognition: You grow best from a safe position, with the training done and the support in place. Because shelter feels like the right place to prepare, you stay in comfortable roles past the point they teach you anything, and you wait for one more sign that you are ready. You are readier than you feel, and you have been for a long time.
Growth.lived: From your late teens you have grown in steady steps, each one taken only after you felt well prepared. You have stayed somewhere safe for longer than it served you at least once, and you did better than you feared once you finally moved.
